mapper.sql: id, customer_id, opportunity_id, contract_no, title, amount, status, signed_at, expire_at, file_url, remark, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, deleted
mapper.update: UPDATE opc_crm_contract SET customer_id = #{customerId}, opportunity_id = #{opportunityId}, title = #{title}, amount = #{amount}, status = #{status}, signed_at = #{signedAt}, expire_at = #{expireAt}, file_url = #{fileUrl}, remark = #{remark}, deleted = #{deleted}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT ct.id, ct.customer_id, ct.opportunity_id, ct.contract_no, ct.title, ct.amount, ct.status, ct.signed_at, ct.expire_at, ct.file_url, ct.remark, ct.create_by, ct.create_time, ct.update_by, ct.update_time, ct.deleted FROM opc_crm_contract ct JOIN opc_crm_customer cu ON cu.id = ct.customer_id WHERE ct.id = #{id} AND cu.owner_id = #{ownerId} AND ct.deleted = 0 AND cu.deleted = 0

SELECT ct.id, ct.customer_id, ct.opportunity_id, ct.contract_no, ct.title, ct.amount, ct.status, ct.signed_at, ct.expire_at, ct.file_url, ct.remark, ct.create_by, ct.create_time, ct.update_by, ct.update_time, ct.deleted FROM opc_crm_contract ct JOIN opc_crm_customer cu ON cu.id = ct.customer_id WHERE ct.customer_id = #{customerId} AND cu.owner_id = #{ownerId} AND ct.deleted = 0 AND cu.deleted = 0 ORDER BY ct.create_time DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM opc_crm_contract WHERE contract_no = #{contractNo}
